name: Goi toi
summary: Gỏi tỏi is Lý Sơn’s young-garlic salad, tossed with sweet-sour fish sauce and roasted peanuts and often with shrimp, pork belly, and rau răm. The garlic smells strong but not harsh, and the salad is rich, nutty, sour, and hot.
taste: Vietnam Airlines says the smell is strong but not harsh, and the plate is rich, nutty, sour, and hot. ZaloPay says mildly hot, rich, and cool.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: only in the season when the garlic starts to bulb. Steam the young garlic, shred it, and mix it with boiled shrimp, pork belly, rau răm, roasted peanuts, and sweet-sour fish sauce.
ZaloPay: the young garlic stem, mixed with sweet-sour fish sauce. Shrimp and pork may be added. Roasted peanuts go on last.
seoTitle: Goi toi — young-garlic salad on Ly Son
seoDescription: Gỏi tỏi, Lý Sơn’s young-garlic salad with sweet-sour fish sauce, peanuts, shrimp, and pork belly. 120,000 VND a plate.
